drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. Attached is the revised draft, with the compensation and severance provisions restored and a proposed Schedule A identifying the Base Salary and Severance Amount for completion. Those two economic figures remain bracketed because they were not included in the draft we received; please provide your client’s proposed figures, or we can circulate a completed schedule once the figures are confirmed. We have also revised the post-employment restriction to limit its duration, geographic reach, and covered competitive activity. We welcome your comments on that language.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of USD [●] (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings. The Executive shall also be eligible to participate in the Company’s employee benefit plans generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of those plans.
edits.name: Section 2

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Executive shall receive, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims, severance equal to twelve (12) months of Base Salary (the “Severance Amount”), payable in substantially equal installments over twelve (12) months in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices. The Severance Amount is subject to applicable withholdings.
edits.name: Section 3

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. For six (6) months following the end of the Executive’s employment, the Executive shall not, within the geographic area in which the Executive materially performed services for the Company during the twelve (12) months preceding termination, perform for a business that competes with the Company in a business line in which the Executive materially participated during that period services substantially similar to those the Executive performed for the Company. This restriction does not prohibit the Executive from holding, solely as a passive investment, not more than two percent (2%) of the outstanding securities of a publicly traded company.
edits.name: Section 4

edits.text: Schedule A — Compensation Terms | Base Salary: USD [●] per year | Severance Amount: twelve (12) months of Base Salary, subject to Section 3
